info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Auto Insurance Quotes Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Status API allows users to easily retrieve the current status of their auto insurance quotes. This endpoint is designed for insurance agents and policyholders who need to track the progress of quote applications. Utilizing the status information, users can gain insights into pending, approved, or rejected quotes, ensuring they remain informed throughout the insurance application process. By accessing these statuses, consumers can effectively manage their insurance decisions.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of quotes available in the system. It provides information on whether quotes are active, expired, or under review, aiding users in tracking the lifecycle of their quotes effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of quotes. Please ensure that the payload conforms to the expected schema for accurate processing.

200.description: The request was successful and the status data is returned.

ListAutoInsuranceQuotesStatusRequest.title: String Quote Status
ListAutoInsuranceQuotesStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the status code provided in a GET request for quotes. It is expected to be a string representation of the status.
